A great hangover kit combines  [Highlight start] **rehydration**, **symptom relief**, **quick snacks** , and **refreshing personal care** [Highlight end] tailored to your event or budget.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1xYrUtmSRkxUqwF6yEJbGyjp0A9VNDrXtXFXfl63FdUvsOnprB83TLHZ1TIGNbYCWMJ6c6ztq3vMQbLNa9eqj-qLoH3drBqd3YFJBlCaJeK-mhObSG9NXINycGZ6VJd9RzcqGBbrQV65eDY5dKMTiu_GsueEKFH4TWiPzJzgIWBhaVZS)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQEFtvOZ38Oa5fBDgJMP8w47Tu2NN1bPadVNcQuRkgmHlFdgk90ZbS7sYdE5nf14Y1zhY9sKSe8RVnsEQvoMu1Dy2hVIuZHlVDWA7rFnrkk8qDk6UQOPZVXdEdmv9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXYC7AbrldNogP5m9ROC-_htLl-dsCUwZ_tYdzvRVYcOSp5di2zd57f-hOH1rib02L3M2K2P-3KE3Ve20MM1WhuH8tkAKvuL2bX5AZeDbmnW1OI6r75pr-lX1XPQkmTto)

### Core Essentials

- **Hydration:** Electrolyte powder packets or tablets (like [Liquid I.V.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462576459595183,imageDocid:10128521174687172242,gpcid:633602903548162757,headlineOfferDocid:1376781439152858314,catalogid:10511523016409341249,productDocid:18160173188712481673,rds:PC_10893961444779289638%7CPROD_PC_10893961444779289638&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizyLn5h6CYAxXnGhAIHVGyPEUQxa4PegYIAggLEBg), [Emergen-C](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462899974081704,imageDocid:4702857515834561313,gpcid:12563846208521746048,headlineOfferDocid:12592213315387090505,catalogid:16039278759994680761,productDocid:2831904114103313402,rds:PC_12563846208521746048%7CPROD_PC_12563846208521746048&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizyLn5h6CYAxXnGhAIHVGyPEUQxa4PegYIAggLEBk) , or hydration tablets), bottled water, or sports drinks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjyxJtZt871bYD7zuRJgCA537N6s1K8qt77fcom2fUIZa4eOr_DXQFq-KcOsDJzUteWDfBlqs8uVQpV8qK28qvOBzSYg_h1g9pPrsVwjWH8iAb9bRRMJ7STeaIiE9KUfT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQEFtvOZ38Oa5fBDgJMP8w47Tu2NN1bPadVNcQuRkgmHlFdgk90ZbS7sYdE5nf14Y1zhY9sKSe8RVnsEQvoMu1Dy2hVIuZHlVDWA7rFnrkk8qDk6UQOPZVXdEdmv9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Q7SgIoDFk7T1V43VxelpiJC69OcxGFvq-I-XrCYWhxGWr4SMIi-Y16psXgIrhJnUcUilRhnRMyQii7rgYRhLF8FMmLAGNHVrVwyEDH_f-h8-QeFhXosselnYizI6XTnp7aYc50IFAY5nDcodS2WVEz9bzf4Q-Pt6rHTwa_2lojxmdvJrbXQfrZC7IOVivdtrSuI2_74K7Ey8ebzhHHwg)
- **Symptom relief:** Single-dose pain relievers (ibuprofen, acetaminophen, or aspirin) and antacids or upset-stomach tablets (like [Tums](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462830230727859,imageDocid:15322911152164344769,gpcid:2654590303527875032,headlineOfferDocid:10660918099575667519,catalogid:6915899451931753357,productDocid:6177141404220568124,rds:PC_2654590303527875032%7CPROD_PC_2654590303527875032&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizyLn5h6CYAxXnGhAIHVGyPEUQxa4PegYIAggmEAA) or [Pepto-Bismol](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462914862174222,imageDocid:2611930560446931960,gpcid:4618055632557879858,headlineOfferDocid:9672963889171738098,catalogid:10687152004220446747,productDocid:12176695038507958519,rds:PC_4618055632557879858%7CPROD_PC_4618055632557879858&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwizyLn5h6CYAxXnGhAIHVGyPEUQxa4PegYIAggmEAE)).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjyxJtZt871bYD7zuRJgCA537N6s1K8qt77fcom2fUIZa4eOr_DXQFq-KcOsDJzUteWDfBlqs8uVQpV8qK28qvOBzSYg_h1g9pPrsVwjWH8iAb9bRRMJ7STeaIiE9KUfT)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQEFtvOZ38Oa5fBDgJMP8w47Tu2NN1bPadVNcQuRkgmHlFdgk90ZbS7sYdE5nf14Y1zhY9sKSe8RVnsEQvoMu1Dy2hVIuZHlVDWA7rFnrkk8qDk6UQOPZVXdEdmv9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF19Q7SgIoDFk7T1V43VxelpiJC69OcxGFvq-I-XrCYWhxGWr4SMIi-Y16psXgIrhJnUcUilRhnRMyQii7rgYRhLF8FMmLAGNHVrVwyEDH_f-h8-QeFhXosselnYizI6XTnp7aYc50IFAY5nDcodS2WVEz9bzf4Q-Pt6rHTwa_2lojxmdvJrbXQfrZC7IOVivdtrSuI2_74K7Ey8ebzhHHwg)
- **Snacks:** Protein or granola bars, trail mix, ginger chews, mints, or gum.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQEFtvOZ38Oa5fBDgJMP8w47Tu2NN1bPadVNcQuRkgmHlFdgk90ZbS7sYdE5nf14Y1zhY9sKSe8RVnsEQvoMu1Dy2hVIuZHlVDWA7rFnrkk8qDk6UQOPZVXdEdmv9)
- **Refresh & comfort:** Travel-size mouthwash or toothbrush/toothpaste, face or makeup wipes, lip balm, eye drops, under-eye patches, earplugs, and a sleep mask.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXk9f1W0lvj3O57qqx1Qu33MAl2FL1LYrHo4B0GF9SSQwLCxsHmV6mbFkPTt7ydRBZ6J3nrOFDh9_s8FW0OHRAC3oMqOhxQjVfa7BPU6MumpHdUYfuha0dacGZRKAKE4WF8p42urGLo56uoPuYjyPYtqOYeOud)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQEFtvOZ38Oa5fBDgJMP8w47Tu2NN1bPadVNcQuRkgmHlFdgk90ZbS7sYdE5nf14Y1zhY9sKSe8RVnsEQvoMu1Dy2hVIuZHlVDWA7rFnrkk8qDk6UQOPZVXdEdmv9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXYC7AbrldNogP5m9ROC-_htLl-dsCUwZ_tYdzvRVYcOSp5di2zd57f-hOH1rib02L3M2K2P-3KE3Ve20MM1WhuH8tkAKvuL2bX5AZeDbmnW1OI6r75pr-lX1XPQkmTto)

### Theme & Event Ideas

- **Bachelorette or girls' trip:** Use personalized drawstring pouches, canvas cosmetic bags, or reusable tumblers. Add under-eye gel patches, hair ties or scrunchies, and stain-remover wipes. Check out [The Knot](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXk9f1W0lvj3O57qqx1Qu33MAl2FL1LYrHo4B0GF9SSQwLCxsHmV6mbFkPTt7ydRBZ6J3nrOFDh9_s8FW0OHRAC3oMqOhxQjVfa7BPU6MumpHdUYfuha0dacGZRKAKE4WF8p42urGLo56uoPuYjyPYtqOYeOud) for bachelorette bag and item ideas, or browse customizable kits on [Etsy](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX7hmfYAGQFscTWVu3IHfGGNERz-zToKiiteSl8WfYz3njGjXO7N6O8I1T4GN2pbsBeUJDeS1Bk-GHSqt0kcpLfIsgdje87EJ5oBV0tZmFw6vcVeWmllOyCn0_NuIYxQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXk9f1W0lvj3O57qqx1Qu33MAl2FL1LYrHo4B0GF9SSQwLCxsHmV6mbFkPTt7ydRBZ6J3nrOFDh9_s8FW0OHRAC3oMqOhxQjVfa7BPU6MumpHdUYfuha0dacGZRKAKE4WF8p42urGLo56uoPuYjyPYtqOYeOud)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXhObl2QaALeKKQMVxZYcV4EEXuFzEcA5tpZsP0_OfwbYZ9lhilSz-7EYFTSVYgbvMzYVNBJVZI7H_b_IkIeVklQIxDSwmyu7kk97Duc7LfNO68W0dxJWcKSVhbR5i-wRwEZCWMoDC1A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX7hmfYAGQFscTWVu3IHfGGNERz-zToKiiteSl8WfYz3njGjXO7N6O8I1T4GN2pbsBeUJDeS1Bk-GHSqt0kcpLfIsgdje87EJ5oBV0tZmFw6vcVeWmllOyCn0_NuIYxQ)
- **Destination wedding:** Include sunblock packets, SPF lip balm, aloe vera gel, blister pads or Band-Aids, and travel tissues for outdoor or multi-day trips. See [Destination Wedding Details](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1xYrUtmSRkxUqwF6yEJbGyjp0A9VNDrXtXFXfl63FdUvsOnprB83TLHZ1TIGNbYCWMJ6c6ztq3vMQbLNa9eqj-qLoH3drBqd3YFJBlCaJeK-mhObSG9NXINycGZ6VJd9RzcqGBbrQV65eDY5dKMTiu_GsueEKFH4TWiPzJzgIWBhaVZS) for 18 wedding guest kit ideas.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1xYrUtmSRkxUqwF6yEJbGyjp0A9VNDrXtXFXfl63FdUvsOnprB83TLHZ1TIGNbYCWMJ6c6ztq3vMQbLNa9eqj-qLoH3drBqd3YFJBlCaJeK-mhObSG9NXINycGZ6VJd9RzcqGBbrQV65eDY5dKMTiu_GsueEKFH4TWiPzJzgIWBhaVZS)
- **Budget DIY:** Stock up on travel-size toiletries, pain relievers, and drink mixes at dollar stores or warehouse clubs and pack them into clear zip pouches or gift bags.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXeWwDAyPoB7MI0vT_vdmy98ahUEdrDxBuar__bPhwKJTl5FD55wY66UayIdDsoCs9uO2EVZU7oi_y5U5SdcAzJeazuLpHl7k_cfioA97jFX9LWcPt03V1VYvvjUgkEwoshA)
- **Pre-packed kits:** Ready-made hangover kits typically range from **$2 to $35** , with options like pre-filled party favor pouches on [Amazon](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF182nwyIZFbgzSIgmnD7V8lJDrZG0FsJrgKX2kb2JgpJnknOAH2UiMG627Ij_kD3uVUir4iz0RS09Y7bc5pJ6F3A0Dizy2s6q6t2ryP7er0NA9TO3TCVLMBVxLe7_HuG38GGSs7weSTVFpTWdj67y1QBPpX5lSHFw6Tvus92AoM6_DqXEggW7KIg) or tin survival kits such as the Gentlemen's Hardware Hangover Kit around **$22**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF182nwyIZFbgzSIgmnD7V8lJDrZG0FsJrgKX2kb2JgpJnknOAH2UiMG627Ij_kD3uVUir4iz0RS09Y7bc5pJ6F3A0Dizy2s6q6t2ryP7er0NA9TO3TCVLMBVxLe7_HuG38GGSs7weSTVFpTWdj67y1QBPpX5lSHFw6Tvus92AoM6_DqXEggW7KIg)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:16608910387829912140,catalogid:805470702040156677,gpcid:134584016944005395,mid:576462840588607488&ibp=oshop)

Check out The Knot for bachelorette bag and item ideas, or browse customizable kits on Etsy. Destination wedding: Include sunblock packets, SPF lip balm, aloe vera gel, blister pads or Band-Aids, and travel tissues for outdoor or multi-day trips.
